title: Joint Effort 2.0 : Evaluation Among General Population
official: " Joint Effort 2.0 " Une Application Mobile de prévention et de réduction Des méfaits: évaluation auprès de Consommateurs de Cannabis
summary: This study aims to evaluate a mobile app designed to promote the safe use of cannabis among adult users in Quebec.

interventions.name: Brief normative feedback and standard information

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Aged 18 years old or older
* Be an active non-medical cannabis user (ie. self reported past month usage)
* Understand, read and write French
* Own a smartphone (iPhone)

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
sponsor: Centre hospitalier de l'Université de Montréal (CHUM)
